summary: AudioCodes Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held September 9, 2026, at its principal executive offices in Or Yehuda, Israel. Each agenda item was voted upon and approved by the required shareholder majority, per the explanatory note; the filing names no specific proposals, vote tallies, or board recommendations beyond approval. No special-situation transaction, price, stake, premium, advisor, or closing date is disclosed. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer meeting-result notice, the US-equivalent of an 8-K Item 5.07 submission. Nothing to arbitrage; watch for any subsequent 6-K disclosing actual resolution details.
